# Grounded

> Grounded is a browser-based shared construction workspace where external AI agents and construction professionals collaborate on judgments that depend on precise construction document interpretation.

The public demo covers one Type C door Submittal Review. External Agents use eight WebMCP tools to inspect prepared Document Evidence, navigate the visible document workspace, create an Assistance Request, and retrieve the Human Reviewer's Professional Response. Project data stays in the browser for the Demo Session.

## Project

- [Open the Grounded demo](https://grounded-demo.keegangaffney.com/): Use the live Project Workspace in a WebMCP-capable client.
- [Grounded on GitHub](https://github.com/Skeegan123/grounded-demo): Read the source code, setup instructions, and project overview.

## Documentation

- [WebMCP contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Skeegan123/grounded-demo/main/docs/webmcp-point-set-contract.md): Review the eight public tools, their inputs, outputs, limits, and recovery behavior.
- [Door Package Submittal Review demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Skeegan123/grounded-demo/main/docs/door-package-submittal-review-demo.md): Follow the tested demo workflow and judge checklist.
